name: Shibuya Seiji
source:
President of Rain Communication Network.
He used to be a yankee who wasn't pushed and was the leader of the group.
He is a hard worker who studied hard because of something and went on to a famous university in the United States.

[From [url=https://ikemen.cybird.ne.jp/title/nemurihime/chara/seiji_shibuya.html]official website[/url]]
